context:
Goal: on the open Duo, Card in Hand shows who sent the card and the Post button at the same time.
Problem: today, on every card you hold, the Post offer scrolls the seller's name off the top of the page. The test measured the seller at y=-131, above the screen.
Departs from: HandScreen.swift envelope. The Post offer moves from under the card lines to under "It came from" and the seller.
Departs from: HandModel.swift post. After Post, saved or refused, the offer's space stays as a receipt instead of vanishing, so no line moves under your finger.
The builder (sonnet) is building A now. It is easy to undo if you pick B.

options.gain: The sender and Post both show. It needs no keyboard measurement.
options.how: Post sits right under "It came from" and the seller. After Post, its space stays as a receipt.
options.label: Offer under the sender
options.lose: The offer no longer sits under the card lines.

options.how: The lines stay in today's order, and Post is pinned just above the keyboard.
options.label: Keep today's order, pin the offer above the keys
options.lose: It needs an unmeasured 44 pt pad. If the keys draw higher, Post sits under them and you can't scroll to it.

ref: duo-card-in-hand (On the iPhone Duo, Card in Hand checks cards in by name)
title: Post offer sits under the sender on the open Duo
why: A is the only option that doesn't rest on an unmeasured keyboard figure.
